notes.title: DRP is Launching on February 19th 2014!
notes.content:
[b]After almost a year on Steam Early Access, DRP will finally launch on February 19th at $14.99. [/b]

Come see the [url=http://twitch.tv/dejobaan]12 hour Dev MEGASTREAM on Feb 20th[/url]

The game will have: 
[list]
    [*]Story Mode with 52 levels
    [*]Survival and Cocktail Hunter Modes
    [*]26 weeks of [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=WBVllGb4QZs]Drunken Robot Battle Royal weekly[/url] challenges
    [*]Giant Robot Construction Kit and Arena Builder
[/list]
Wish us luck!
Team Dejobaan
